name: sillytalk
description: Chat with AI characters: Node.js backend + Angular frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && npx playwright test && node ../scripts/discard-unchanged-screenshots.mjs
